messages.subject: endoR for birds
parts:
Hi Mike, 

I'm trying to apply NicheMapR on resting and flying birds. I read the "?endoR" and found only parameters for "Fur" properties (e.g. hair diameter, hair length, hair density, depth of compressed fur). If I'm modeling a bird, can I just use "Feather" data (say, feather diameter, feather length, feather density, insulation depth) as values of these parameters?

Your help would be most appreciated!

Best,

Liang

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: endoR for birds
parts:
Hi Liang,

Yes that's the way to go about it. Feathers are a little different to fur, esp. in relation to the penetration of solar radiation. Ideally we'd have something more specific for feathers in there. There are a number of examples in the literature of the application of the endotherm model to birds so check out what they've done. Main thing is to test it out of course.

Also, we're in the process of finalising the endoR model for release and there will be a few minor changes, including some improvements to the panting algorithm.

All the best,
Mike
